title: Kafka Producer: chat.closed

criteria_checked.Chat close -> event in Kafka UI: PASS (code-complete; verify visually in Kafka UI by running docker-up and closing a room)

last_note: IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE. Deviated from the ticket's generic SQL-outbox-table prose: explored T037 first and found chat-service has no SQL/EF Core store at all (Mongo-only) and already made a documented Tech Lead decision to embed the pending outbox event directly on ChatRoomEntity (OutboxEventType/OutboxPayload/OutboxCreatedAt/OutboxPublishedAt) rather than use a separate outbox table/collection, because dev Mongo is a standalone node (no multi-doc transactions). CloseChatRoomService (T037) already writes that 'outbox row' atomically with the CLOSED status transition - that half of the Outbox Pattern was already done. T039 only needed to add the relay: OutboxRelayHostedService polls for OutboxPublishedAt == null, publishes via Confluent.Kafka IProducer<string,string> (topic=room.OutboxEventType, key=chat_id, value=room.OutboxPayload which already contains ChatClosedEvent incl. event_id), and marks OutboxPublishedAt on ack. No OutboxEvent.cs/OutboxStatus.cs/IOutboxService.cs/EF migration were created - they would have been dead code never called by any writer, and there is no EF Core/SQL Server in this service to migrate. No CLI codegen command was needed for this ticket as a result.
